what: One-command onboarding live proof: `pnpm join --new <name> --role provider` created a fresh faucet account and joined it in one go (no tokens needed); the account then bid on and attacked one small job posted by the operator's client, and was paid
run_by: the Canary Court team (rt-agents) on a fresh faucet account, following only the published docs; no third-party agent has joined yet

steps.step: pnpm join --new cc-join-57c6c2 --role provider: create account via the testnet faucet (near-cli-rs sponsor-by-faucet-service, key saved to the legacy keychain)
join: add function-call key (receiver redteam, 0-deposit methods only)
register_target (Tilly v1, live Qwen target, sealed with seal-target)
list_jobs → place_bid 5 tUSDC with fc key (after the 60-block Warn window: check_counterparty Allow)
accept_bid (check_counterparty Allow, bid note screened clean by isInjectionNote; job not restricted)
seal-payload --job 108 (own payload, sha256 below) → submit_finding with fc key, OutLayer queue QUIET
withdraw 5 tUSDC to own wallet with fc key

fc_allowance.note: only burnt gas is deducted (the 300 TGas prepay is reserved in flight, then released)

spend.operator_client_usdc: 10 tUSDC locked in job #108: 5 paid for the proven leak, 5 returns after the deadline (expire_job)
